24	## 1. Claude Code 能否自动把 session 对话和操作日志记录到项目 `logs/xxx.md`？
25	
26	**部分支持，但需要你自己用 hooks / export 脚本落地。**
27	
28	Claude Code 官方会持续保存 session，本地 transcript 默认在：
29	
30	```text
31	~/.claude/projects/<project>/<session-id>.jsonl
32	```
33	
34	也可以在会话里用 `/export` 把当前 conversation 保存为纯文本文件；官方文档还说明这些本地 session 文件默认 30 天后清理，可通过配置调整。([Claude Code][1])
35	
36	但是，**Claude Code 默认不会自动把完整对话保存到当前 repo 的 `logs/` 目录**。要做到这一点，推荐用 hooks。Claude Code hooks 能在 `SessionStart`、`UserPromptSubmit`、`PreToolUse`、`PostToolUse`、`Stop`、`SubagentStart/Stop`、`TaskCreated/Completed`、`SessionEnd` 等生命周期事件触发；hook 输入里包含 `session_id`、`cwd`、`transcript_path` 等信息。([Claude Code][2])
37	
38	你项目里其实已经有一个基础版本：`audit_event.py` 会从 hook stdin 读取 JSON payload，然后写到当前项目的 `.agent/audit/tool-events.jsonl`，字段包括 `timestamp`、`hook_event_name`、`tool_name`、`session_id`、`cwd` 和完整 payload。 这说明你的项目已经具备 **tool-event audit log**，但还没有完整的 **conversation transcript mirror / session summary log**。
39	
40	我建议分三层做：
41	
42	```text
43	.agent/audit/
44	  tool-events.jsonl              # raw hook events, 默认不提交或只提交 sanitized 样例
45	
46	logs/claude-sessions/
47	  <date>-<session-id>.jsonl       # transcript mirror，可选，不建议默认 commit
48	  <date>-<session-id>.summary.md  # curated session summary，可 review 后 commit
49	
50	docs/handoffs/
51	  m9-handoff.md
52	  m10-handoff.md                  # milestone 级别核心记忆，应该 commit
53	```
54	
55	关键安全建议：**不要默认把完整 transcript commit 到 GitHub**。Claude session 里可能包含本地路径、命令输出、错误日志、环境变量片段、PR 链接、甚至误打印的 secret。更好的做法是：
56	
57	```text
58	raw logs:
59	  .agent/audit/**
60	  logs/claude-sessions/raw/**
61	  默认 .gitignore
62	
63	curated memory:
64	  PROJECT_STATE.md
65	  docs/handoffs/*.md
66	  docs/adr/*.md
67	  docs/meeting-notes/*.md
68	  docs/evidence/*.md
69	  review 后 commit
70	```
71	
72	可以让 Claude Code 加一个 skill：
73	
74	```text
75	.claude/skills/session-closeout/SKILL.md
76	```
77	
78	用途是每次长任务结束后生成：
79	
80	```text
81	- What changed
82	- Files changed
83	- Tests run
84	- Decisions made
85	- Open questions
86	- Follow-up issues to create
87	- Memory updates proposed
88	```
89	
90	然后由 human 批准后更新 `PROJECT_STATE.md`、`docs/handoffs/`、ADR 或 GitHub issue。

94	## 2. Claude Code 支持 GitHub webhook 吗？能否响应 PR review / comments / labels？
95	
96	**支持几种不同层级，但要区分 “GitHub Actions 触发新 agent run” 和 “push 事件进入正在运行的本地 session”。**
97	
98	### 方案 A：GitHub Actions + `@claude`，最稳
99	
100	你现在已经有 `.github/workflows/claude.yml`，它监听：
101	
102	```yaml
103	issue_comment:
104	  types: [created]
105	pull_request_review_comment:
106	  types: [created]
107	issues:
108	  types: [opened, assigned]
109	pull_request_review:
110	  types: [submitted]
111	```
112	
113	并且只有 comment / issue / review body 包含 `@claude` 时才运行 Claude Code Action。 官方文档也确认 Claude Code GitHub Actions 可以通过 PR/issue 中的 `@claude` 触发，分析代码、创建 PR、实现功能和修 bug，并且 action 是基于 Claude Agent SDK 构建的。([Claude Code][3])
114	
115	这适合：
116	
117	```text
118	@claude review this PR
119	@claude implement issue #123
120	@claude summarize unresolved review comments
121	@claude update docs based on this decision
122	```
123	
124	如果你想让它更新 issue comments / labels / PR comments，workflow 权限需要从 read 扩到 write，例如：
125	
126	```yaml
127	permissions:
128	  contents: write
129	  pull-requests: write
130	  issues: write
131	  actions: read
132	  id-token: write
133	```
134	
135	但我建议分 workflow：
136	
137	```text
138	claude.yml
139	  手动 @claude 响应，允许 contents/pull-requests/issues write
140	
141	claude-code-review.yml
142	  自动 PR review，默认只读或只写 review comment
143	
144	issue-triage.yml
145	  label/comment triage，issues: write，但不改代码
146	
147	labels-sync.yml
148	  只同步 .github/labels.yml，需要人工 workflow_dispatch
149	```
150	
151	工程实践文档里的 AI pickup rule 很适合这里：implementation agent 只能处理 open issue、带 `ai:ready`、决策已 `decision:confirmed`、有 acceptance criteria、无 `ai:blocked`，且不涉及 secrets/破坏性 migration/生产 infra/客户可见副作用，除非 human 明确批准。
152	
153	### 方案 B：Claude Code Routines + GitHub trigger，云端事件触发
154	
155	Claude Code Routines 支持 schedule、API trigger、GitHub event trigger，运行在 Anthropic-managed cloud infrastructure；GitHub trigger 会在匹配事件发生时启动一个新 session。([Claude Code][4]) 官方文档说明 GitHub triggers 当前支持 PR 和 release 两类事件，PR 事件包括 opened、closed、assigned、labeled、synchronized 等；每个匹配事件都会启动独立 session，不复用之前的 session。([Claude Code][4])
156	
157	这适合：
158	
159	```text
160	PR labeled ai:ready → 新 cloud session 生成 plan
161	PR updated → 自动 review diff
162	release created → 生成 release notes / readiness report
163	nightly → issue backlog grooming
164	```
165	
166	但它不适合保存“一个长期本地 session 的连续上下文”，因为每个 GitHub event 是新 session。你的 repo memory 仍然要靠 GitHub 文件和 issue/PR 记录。
167	
168	### 方案 C：Claude Code Channels，把 webhook 推进正在运行的本地 session
169	
170	Claude Code Channels 是另一类东西：它允许 MCP server 把 messages、alerts、webhooks 推入一个正在运行的 Claude Code session。官方说它可用于 CI results、chat messages、monitoring events，让 Claude 在你离开终端时也能反应；这是 research preview，需要 Claude Code v2.1.80+，并且 session 启动时要用 `--channels` opt-in。([Claude Code][5]) Channels reference 说明 channel 本质是 MCP server，通过 `notifications/claude/channel` 把外部事件送进 Claude Code session，可做 one-way webhook 或 two-way chat bridge。([Claude Code][6])
171	
172	这适合：
173	
174	```text
175	GitHub webhook → local channel server → active Arch Claude session
176	CI failed → Claude sees event immediately
177	Issue label changed → Claude receives payload
178	PR review submitted → Claude receives payload and responds
179	```
180	
181	但它更复杂，且是 research preview。我建议你的路线是：
182	
183	```text
184	短期：
185	  GitHub Actions @claude + issue labels/comments
186	
187	中期：
188	  Routines 处理 cloud-side GitHub event automation
189	
190	高级：
191	  Channels 将 selected GitHub webhook 推入正在运行的 Arch session
192	```

196	## 3. 如何从 GitHub comments 中提取需求确认/设计变更并沉淀为核心记忆？
197	
198	这件事不能让 Claude “看到评论就直接改 PROJECT_STATE”。应该用 **两阶段 memory promotion**：
199	
200	```text
201	GitHub comment/review/label event
202	  ↓
203	Issue Triage / Decision Extractor agent
204	  ↓
205	生成 proposed memory patch
206	  ↓
207	human review
208	  ↓
209	更新核心记忆文件
210	```
211	
212	我建议新增这些文件：
213	
214	```text
215	.claude/agents/github-decision-extractor.md
216	.claude/agents/github-issue-triage.md
217	.claude/agents/pr-review-followup.md
218	
219	.claude/skills/github-comment-distill/SKILL.md
220	.claude/skills/memory-promotion/SKILL.md
221	.claude/skills/pr-closeout-review/SKILL.md
222	```
223	
224	`github-comment-distill` 的职责：
225	
226	```text
227	输入：
228	  issue/PR comments, review comments, labels, PR diff, linked task doc
229	
230	输出：
231	  confirmed_requirements:
232	  changed_requirements:
233	  confirmed_design_decisions:
234	  changed_design_decisions:
235	  open_questions:
236	  blockers:
237	  proposed_labels:
238	  proposed_core_memory_patch:
239	```
240	
241	`memory-promotion` 的职责：
242	
243	```text
244	只生成 patch，不直接 claim truth：
245	- PROJECT_STATE.md patch
246	- docs/adr/xxxx.md draft
247	- docs/tasks/Mx-Txxx.md update
248	- docs/handoffs/mx-handoff.md update
249	- GitHub issue comment summary
250	```
251	
252	沉淀规则建议：
253	
254	```text
255	comment 只是 evidence，不自动成为 truth
256	label decision:confirmed + human 明确 wording 才能进入 ADR / PROJECT_STATE
257	模糊评论 → decision:needed + ai:blocked
258	实现细节 → task doc / PR closeout
259	长期架构决策 → ADR
260	milestone 状态 → PROJECT_STATE / docs/milestones.md
261	```
262	
263	这和你的工程实践文档一致：Issue Triage Agent 可以读 comments 并识别问题是否已解决，但不能从模糊评论推断决策；Implementation Agent 只能在确认后的 issue 上工作。

267	## 4. agents/skills 如何迁移到别的项目？
268	
269	**不要直接无脑复制到目标项目根目录。最佳方式是“staging → audit → adapt → install”。**
270	
271	Claude Code skills 是文件系统 artifact，项目级 skills 放在：
272	
273	```text
274	.claude/skills/<skill-name>/SKILL.md
275	```
276	
277	个人级 skills 放在：
278	
279	```text
280	~/.claude/skills/<skill-name>/SKILL.md
281	```
282	
283	官方文档说明 project skills 只对当前项目生效，personal skills 对所有项目生效，plugin skills 通过 plugin namespace 生效；skills 的 body 只在使用时加载，适合把重复流程从 `CLAUDE.md` 中拆出来。([Claude Code][7]) Agent SDK 也支持从 `.claude/skills/`、`~/.claude/skills/` 或 plugin 路径发现 filesystem skills。([Claude Code][8])
284	
285	我建议采用四层复用模型：
286	
287	### A. 通用、无项目耦合：做成 personal skill 或内部 plugin
288	
289	例如：
290	
291	```text
292	pr-closeout-review
293	github-comment-distill
294	session-closeout
295	ci-failure-triage
296	test-coverage-review
297	```
298	
299	可以放：
300	
301	```text
302	~/.claude/skills/
303	```
304	
305	或建立一个内部 repo：
306	
307	```text
308	kca-agent-pack/
309	  skills/
310	  agents/
311	  hooks/
312	  templates/
313	  README.md
314	```
315	
316	然后每个项目通过 submodule/subtree 或脚本安装。
317	
318	### B. 项目相关但可复用：先放 staging
319	
320	目标项目里先放：
321	
322	```text
323	.agent-import-staging/kca-agent-pack/
324	```
325	
326	然后让 Claude Code 执行：
327	
328	```text
329	Analyze .agent-import-staging/kca-agent-pack.
330	For each skill/agent:
331	- classify as reusable / needs adaptation / reject
332	- identify project-specific assumptions
333	- identify commands, paths, labels, policies to rewrite
334	- propose final installation path
335	Do not install until plan is approved.
336	```
337	
338	再迁移到：
339	
340	```text
341	.claude/skills/
342	.claude/agents/
343	docs/agent-practices/
344	```
345	
346	### C. 强项目耦合：不要迁移，只迁移理念
347	
348	例如 KCA 专用的 Kaggle approval、competition artifact layout、Supabase schema agent，不适合直接复制到普通 SaaS 项目。应该抽象出：
349	
350	```text
351	approval-gate-review
352	artifact-ledger
353	remote-side-effect-policy
354	```
355	
356	### D. 带脚本的 skills：必须安全审计
357	
358	官方 Agent Skills 文档提醒，Skills 可以包含指令和代码，恶意 Skill 可能诱导 Claude 执行不符合预期的工具或代码，所以只应使用可信来源的 skills。([Claude Platform][9]) 所以迁移时要检查：
359	
360	```text
361	- 是否调用 curl/wget/bash remote code
362	- 是否读取 .env / ssh / cloud credentials
363	- 是否 git push / deploy / delete
364	- 是否写绝对路径
365	- 是否假设某个 repo layout
366	- 是否修改 permissions/hooks
367	```

371	## 5. 产品 release 后是否还依赖 Claude Code？agents/skills/commands 底层调用什么？
372	
373	**KCA 产品 release 后不应该依赖 Claude Code CLI/desktop 本身。** Claude Code 是开发工具；KCA runtime 应该是你自己的 platform worker。
374	
375	你现在项目文档已经把两类 agent 区分得很清楚：Claude Code/VS Code/Desktop/Web 是 platform-development coding agents；runtime competition code agents 是平台内部启动的 agent，初始方向是 Claude Agent SDK、隔离 workspace/container、Kaggle Python/notebook-first、未来 model router 支持 Claude、GPT-style、local vLLM/Ollama 等。
376	
377	更进一步，你当前 M3 里已经把 runtime agent 方向改成了 provider-agnostic：`litellm.completion()` 作为统一 LLM provider interface，Claude、GPT-4o、本地 vLLM/Ollama 可按 job 选择。 这说明 KCA runtime **不是锁死在 Anthropic 模型上**。
378	
379	不过要分清楚几种能力来源：
380	
381	```text
382	Claude Code CLI skills/agents/hooks:
383	  用于开发 KCA repo；依赖 Claude Code。
384	
385	KCA .kca/skills or tools:
386	  你自己定义的产品 runtime skills/tools；不依赖 Claude Code。
387	
388	Claude Agent SDK:
389	  可以作为一种 runtime harness，提供 Claude Code-like agent loop、工具执行、context management。
390	
391	LiteLLM / OpenAI-compatible / vLLM / Ollama:
392	  可以作为 model provider；你要自己实现 tool loop 或通过 KCA worker adapter 接入。
393	
394	KCA commands:
395	  例如 kca run, kca decision, kca kaggle, kca skill；
396	  release 后就是你的产品 CLI/runtime API，不应该依赖 Claude Code。
397	```
398	
399	官方 Claude Agent SDK 的定位是“把 Claude Code 作为 library 构建生产 AI agents”，它提供相同的 tools、agent loop、context management，并且适合 CI/CD、custom applications、production automation。([Claude Code][10]) 但如果你使用 Agent SDK，它主要还是 Claude/Anthropic provider 体系；如果要接 vLLM/Ollama/OpenAI，你需要通过 KCA 的 model router / LiteLLM 路线来承接。
400	
401	我的建议：
402	
403	```text
404	产品 runtime 层：
405	  KCA Worker API
406	    - job runner
407	    - permission policy
408	    - tool executor
409	    - audit/event log
410	    - model router
411	    - GitHub adapter
412	    - Kaggle adapter
413	
414	可插拔 agent backend：
415	  - Claude Agent SDK backend
416	  - LiteLLM tool-loop backend
417	  - OpenAI Responses/Codex backend
418	  - Local vLLM/Ollama backend
419	```
420	
421	这样你可以先用 Claude Agent SDK 获得强 agentic coding 能力，后面逐步替换或混合其他模型。
422

425	## 6. 如何让 Claude Code 在 plan/design/architect 阶段更主动发现问题、提问和 debate？
426	
427	你观察得很对：Claude Code 有时会“按字面完成任务”，不会主动追问隐藏需求。例如你让它接手 `kkr.py/kkr.yaml`，它没有主动发现“多 Kaggle 账户提交”这种重要历史设计理念。其实你的 legacy 工具里已经有不少信号：`kkr.py` 支持 `--env` 覆盖 selected owner 的 dotenv path，`RunManifest` 里有 `owner`、`slug`、`env_path`，`kkr.yaml` 里也出现多个 Kaggle owner/kernel id，例如 `harrysun2006`、`firefly2006`。  
428	
429	要提高主动性，我建议建立一个 **Discovery / Debate Gate**，不是只靠“plan mode”。
430	
431	### 做法 1：每个迁移 legacy 的任务先跑 “design archaeology”
432	
433	新增 skill：
434	
435	```text
436	.claude/skills/design-archaeology/SKILL.md
437	```
438	
439	要求 Claude 在实现前必须输出：
440	
441	```text
442	Legacy design archaeology:
443	1. What workflows does the legacy tool support?
444	2. What hidden assumptions exist?
445	3. What user personas/accounts exist?
446	4. What side effects exist?
447	5. What state files/registries exist?
448	6. What config dimensions exist?
449	7. Which features should be preserved?
450	8. Which features should be deprecated?

511	
512	## 7. 你现在这些实践之外，还能怎么提高开发效率和准确率？
513	
514	你已经有一套很强的 workflow：
515	
516	```text
517	milestones/tasks + worktrees
518	Arch Linux Claude Code --bg 长跑
519	Mac VS Code 做短任务/review
520	mobile app remote control 批准/回答
521	GitHub issues/PR/comments/labels 作为第二交互界面
522	```
523	
524	我建议补齐下面 12 个实践。
525	
526	### 1. 给每个 task 增加 “evidence bundle”
527	
528	每个 PR 必须产出：
529	
530	```text
531	docs/evidence/<task-id>/
532	  closeout.md
533	  commands-run.txt
534	  test-results.md
535	  screenshots-or-traces-index.md
536	  decisions.md
537	```
538	
539	PR body 链接 evidence。工程实践文档也建议 logs 要总结到 issue，并把长期证据放在 `docs/evidence/` 或 GitHub artifact 中。
540	
541	### 2. 建立 “no silent memory” 机制
542	
543	每次 Claude Code 结束时强制问：
544	
545	```text
546	Does this task change project memory?
547	- no
548	- yes: propose patch to PROJECT_STATE.md / ADR / task doc / handoff
549	```
550	
551	只有 human approve 后才更新。
552	
553	### 3. 增加 PR Closeout bot
554	
555	每个 PR 自动检查：
556	
557	```text
558	- linked issue
559	- acceptance criteria checked
560	- tests run
561	- docs updated or not needed
562	- migrations/RLS/secrets impact
563	- remote side effects
564	- evidence link
565	```
566	
567	你的 engineering details 里已经建议 `pr-closeout-check.yml` 用于检查 PR body 是否包含 tests/docs/inventory/closeout links。
568	
569	### 4. 将 “labels” 变成状态机，而不只是标签
570	
571	建议状态流：
572	
573	```text
574	ai:triage
575	  → decision:needed + ai:blocked
576	  → decision:confirmed
577	  → ai:ready
578	  → ai:implementing
579	  → PR opened
580	  → review
581	  → merged / follow-up issues
582	```
583	
584	禁止：
585	
586	```text
587	ai:ready + decision:needed
588	ai:ready + ai:blocked
589	ai:implementing without owner/branch
590	```
591	
592	### 5. 引入 “issue-to-branch naming convention”
593	
594	例如：
595	
596	```text
597	issue #123
598	branch: claude/issue-123-short-title
599	worktree: .worktrees/issue-123-short-title
600	PR title: [#123] Short title
601	```
602	
603	这样 GitHub event、Claude session、worktree、logs、evidence 都能对齐。
604	
605	### 6. 为 Claude Code session 命名
606	
607	Claude Code 支持命名、resume、branch session；session picker 可以按当前 repo/worktree/branch 查找，并且可以导出 transcript。([Claude Code][1]) 你的长跑命令应统一：
608	
609	```bash
610	claude --bg \
611	  --name "M9-T002-spaceship-baseline-issue-123" \
612	  ...
613	```
614	
615	然后 log/evidence 也用同名 ID。
616	
617	### 7. 用 Channels 或 Remote Control 做“响应式开发”，但不要替代 GitHub Actions
618	
619	Remote Control 适合你现在用 mobile app 远程接管本地 session；官方说明 Remote Control 让本地 Claude Code session 继续运行在你的机器上，Web/mobile 只是窗口，适合从手机继续本地任务。([Claude Code][11])
620	
621	Channels 更适合把外部 webhook 推入本地 session。我的建议：
622	
623	```text
624	Remote Control:
625	  人主动介入、批准、回答问题。
626	
627	GitHub Actions:
628	  repo-native 事件、@claude、issue/PR 协作。
629	
630	Channels:
631	  高级事件流，例如 CI failed / PR labeled / issue assigned 推入正在跑的 Arch session。
632	```
633	
634	### 8. 让 KCA 自己 dogfood GitHub interface
635	
636	KCA 产品本身未来要能操作 GitHub，所以现在开发 KCA 时就用同一套抽象：
637	
638	```text
639	GitHub issue/comment/label event
640	  → KCA event adapter
641	  → decision extractor
642	  → job queue
643	  → worker/session
644	  → PR/comment/label update
645	  → audit log
646	```
647	
648	这样你不是“额外做 GitHub automation”，而是在 dogfood 产品核心能力。
649	
650	### 9. legacy migration 要有 behavior parity tests
651	
652	对 `kkr.py/kkr.yaml`，不要只迁移代码。要建立：
653	
654	```text
655	tests/fixtures/kkr/
656	  kkr.yaml
657	  minimal_notebook.ipynb
658	  fake_kaggle_api.json
659	
660	tests/test_kkr_parity.py
661	```
662	
663	覆盖：
664	
665	```text
666	- push --dry-run
667	- submit --dry-run
668	- watch/status/list/fetch parsing
669	- multi-owner env selection
670	- notebook vs local submit
671	- version label / registry behavior
672	```
673	
674	`kkr.py` 已经有 dry-run、JSON output、本地 registry、watch/status/list/fetch 等能力，适合做 parity suite。
675	
676	### 10. 对高风险任务使用双 agent review
677	
678	例如：
679	
680	```text
681	Agent A: implement
682	Agent B: review only
683	Agent C: test coverage reviewer
684	Human: final decision
685	```
686	
687	工程实践文档本身已经把 Inventory Drift Auditor、Issue Triage Agent、Implementation Planner、Implementation Agent、Milestone Reviewer、Test Coverage Reviewer、Release Readiness Agent 分成不同职责，并规定各自不能越权。
688	
689	### 11. 给 runtime worker 增加 replay
690	
691	每个 job 都能：
692	
693	```bash
694	kca job replay <job_id> --from-event <n> --dry-run
695	```
696	
697	这样当 agent 做错时，你可以复现：
698	
699	```text
700	input prompt
701	model/provider
702	tools allowed
703	tool calls
704	policy decisions
705	files changed
706	test results
707	human decisions
708	```
709	
710	M7 的目标里已经有 “permission policy resolves allow/ask/deny” 和 “audit log records every tool execution with policy decision”。 建议把它升级成可 replay 的 event sourcing。
711	
712	### 12. 明确 M9 前的 readiness gate
713	
714	你的 milestones 里 M9 是第一次真实 Kaggle end-to-end regression：Spaceship Titanic，目标是通过审批 gate 执行一次真实 `kaggle competitions submit` 并记录 public LB score。 所以 M9 前一定要 gate：
715

717	- CI green
718	- dry-run path green
719	- Kaggle credentials verified without printing
720	- submission.csv schema validated
721	- approval gate manually tested
722	- rollback / stop criteria documented
723	- logs/evidence path confirmed
724	```

845	## 总结建议
846	
847	你现在的方向是对的，但下一步要把“经验性流程”固化成产品机制：
848	
849	```text
850	Claude Code 开发侧：
851	  hooks + session closeout + GitHub Actions/Routines/Channels + agents/skills
852	
853	KCA runtime 侧：
854	  event log + model router + GitHub adapter + approval gate + replay + evidence bundle
855	
856	共同核心：
857	  GitHub repo 是 source of truth
858	  raw logs 不等于 memory
859	  human-confirmed decisions 才进入 PROJECT_STATE / ADR / milestones
860	```
861	
862	最优先做的不是 M9 继续堆功能，而是 **M8.6：session memory、GitHub event interface、legacy design archaeology、agent/skill reuse packaging**。这会直接提高后续 M9/M10 的开发效率和准确率。

> ### 5. **Milestone Loop Protocol (Key Rules — ~80 words)**
> 
> Located at `docs/milestone-loop-protocol.md`. Key rules:
> 
> 1. **Sequencing:** Loop Prompts execute in order; each must PASS before next; failures retry only that prompt.
> 2. **Side-effects:** No real Anthropic/Kaggle API outside designated paths; default `--dry-run`; no production Supabase changes.
> 3. **Database:** Use local `supabase-db` container (`postgresql://postgres:s3cr3t@172.21.0.4:5432/postgres`); DB calls need `dangerouslyDisableSandbox=true`.
> 4. **Reporting:** Report PASS/FAIL/SKIP inline per prompt; write closeout format at milestone end.
> 5. **Git/GitHub (worktree mode):** Mid-milestone: stage only, no commit. At end: `git add` closeout files, one commit per Loop Prompt (or squash), `git push` worktree branch, `gh pr create` against `main` using final-review as body.
> 6. **Secrets denied always:** `.env*`, `kaggle.json`, `~/.ssh/*`, `~/.aws/**`, `~/.config/gcloud/**`, `secrets/**`.
> 
> ---
> 
> ### 6. **Audit/Memory Infrastructure**
> 
> **Audit logging:**
> - **Hook:** `.claude/hooks/audit_event.py` (40 lines) — appends JSON events to `.agent/audit/tool-events.jsonl` on every tool call
> - **Event shape:** `{timestamp, hook_event_name, tool_name, session_id, cwd, payload}`
> - **Directory:** `.agent/audit/` (created on first use)
> - **DB table:** `agent_tool_audit` (migration 0007_m8_tool_audit.sql) — stores structured tool calls with policy decisions
> 
> **Memory infrastructure:**
> - **Directory:** `memory/` contains:
>   - `MEMORY.md` (index/template)
>   - `feedback_coding_principles.md` (user guidelines)
>   - `kaggle_workflow.md` (workflow notes)
>   - `platform_decisions.md` (architecture snapshots)
>   - `project_m1.md`, `user_profile.md` (historical)
> - **Integration:** Human-maintained; no auto-promotion of transcripts by default (per M9.1 planning doc: "do not commit raw Claude transcripts by default")
> - **KCA module:** `tools/kca/agent/audit.py` — wraps policy decisions + event logging
> 
> **No existing session-closeout skill:** M9/M10 use `milestone-final-review` skill (generates `docs/m{N}-final-review.md` from validation matrix); no per-session memory promotion yet.
>

3	Status: M0–M9 done; M10 in planning (authorized CTF/lab workflow)

5	Scope: hybrid human + AI code competition platform

7	## Product thesis
8	
9	`kaggle-code-agent` is a platform for human users to collaborate with AI code agents on code competitions and authorized challenge environments.
10	
11	Initial focus: Kaggle competitions.  
12	Later extensions: authorized CTF/lab challenges, Devpost, hackathons, benchmark competitions, and other policy-scoped coding contests.
13	
14	The platform should help a human user:
15	
16	- discuss ideas and strategies;
17	- research competition rules, data, notebooks, papers, discussions, and baseline approaches;
18	- create, modify, test, and iterate code;
19	- track experiments, artifacts, results, submissions, and analysis;
20	- require human approval for external side effects such as Kaggle submissions or remote kernel pushes;
21	- summarize learnings and produce final writeups.
22	
23	## Source of truth
24	
25	**GitHub repo + Claude Code + CI + Supabase migrations.**
26	
27	All product source code, migrations, tests, architecture decisions, and task specs live in this repository. AI tools do not share hidden memory reliably across sessions or products. Claude Code is the primary development environment for all layers: CLI, backend, UI shell, and worker.
28	
29	Lovable may be used for visual prototyping or landing-page mockups only. It is not the source of truth for schema, migrations, agent runners, or any backend logic.
30	
31	## Terminology: two meanings of "code agent"
32	
33	This project uses two related but distinct agent concepts.
34	
35	### 1. Platform-development coding agents
36	
37	These are external AI tools used to build this repository.
38	
39	Examples:
40	
41	- Claude Code CLI / VS Code / Desktop / Web (primary);
42	- ChatGPT Pro / Cursor (supplementary);
43	- GitHub Actions / Claude Code Web / Routines for cloud automation.

45	Role:
46	
47	- write and review this product's source code;
48	- update docs, tasks, tests, and architecture decisions;
49	- run local tests and CI repair loops;
50	- open branches/PRs under human supervision.
51	
52	Important rule: these tools do not share hidden memory reliably. GitHub repository files are the durable source of truth.
53	
54	### 2. Runtime competition code agents
55	
56	These are agents launched by the finished platform to help a human user compete.
57	
58	Initial runtime direction:
59	
60	- Claude Agent SDK as the first core worker/harness;
61	- isolated workspace/container per job;
62	- Python/notebook-first for Kaggle;
63	- TypeScript/Python service boundary depending on platform vs worker needs;
64	- future model router for Claude, GPT-style models, local vLLM/Ollama models, and specialized tools.
65	
66	Runtime agents must operate under competition-specific policy, sandboxing, budget limits, approval gates, and audit logging.

71	Human user / future UI
72	        ↓
73	TypeScript-first platform/control plane
74	  - project/session/job/task queue
75	  - policy and approval gates
76	  - discussion/research/analysis records
77	  - experiment/run/submission/artifact records
78	  - model router configuration

83	  - notebooks/scripts/tools/kca wrappers
84	  - Playwright/browser/research tools
85	  - sandboxed execution and evaluation
86	        ↓
87	External systems
88	  - GitHub repo / branches / PRs
89	  - Supabase DB/storage/edge functions later
90	  - Kaggle API/CLI, only with approval for remote side effects
91	  - authorized CTF/lab/hackathon platforms under explicit policy
92	```

94	## Cross-cutting rules
95	
96	- GitHub repo files are the project memory and source of truth.
97	- Each agent task gets a branch/worktree/PR when it modifies code.
98	- Main branch remains stable and protected.
99	- Do not allow multiple AI sessions to edit the same branch/files at the same time.
100	- No secrets in repo, prompts, logs, artifacts, or screenshots.
101	- Kaggle submissions, kernel pushes, dataset uploads, and other remote side effects require explicit human approval.

367	## M7: KCA CLI architecture — command / skill / tool / job / permission policy ✓ done
368	
369	_Shipped 2026-05-21: four-layer CLI scaffold (command/skill/tool/job), skill loader, tool registry (16 tools), three permission profiles, `kca skill list/show/run` + `kca tool list/audit/doctor`, four seed skills, audit JSONL, 15 smoke tests, and `docs/architecture/kca-cli-architecture.md`. 28/28 exit checks PASS — see `docs/m7-final-review.md`._
370	
371	Goal: implement the full KCA command/skill/tool/job architecture so the platform
372	has a stable, inspectable CLI that can drive agent workflows, replace ad-hoc
373	`python tools/kca/kca.py` calls, and enforce structured permission decisions.
374	
375	This is distinct from the product UI shell (M8): M7 is operator/developer-facing
376	and headless. The UI in M8 will call into the same CLI/API surface.
377	
378	See `docs/meeting-notes/2026-05-21-r1.md` §1–3 for full design rationale.
379	
380	### Four-layer model
381	
382	| Layer | Description |
383	|---|---|
384	| **Command** | Deterministic CLI/API entry points for operators (`kca job run`, `kca decision approve`). |
385	| **Skill** | Agent-facing workflow recipes stored under `.kca/skills/<name>/SKILL.md` with YAML frontmatter. Callable via `kca skill run <name>` or slash-style invocation. |
386	| **Tool** | Executable actions with input/output schema, timeout, permission label, sandbox metadata, and audit logging. |
387	| **Job** | Durable records that run a skill through the agent loop with budget, turn, cost, runtime limits, and decision gates. |
388	
389	### M7 task sequence
390	
391	| Task | Description | Depends on |
392	|---|---|---|
393	| M7-T000 | Audit + repair `.github/workflows/` — fix failing CI checks, add no-db + lint jobs | — |
394	| M7-T001 | Skill loader: read `.kca/skills/<name>/SKILL.md` with YAML frontmatter; argument substitution | — |
395	| M7-T002 | Command registry: register KCA CLI subcommands declaratively | T001 |
396	| M7-T003 | Tool registry: tool metadata, approval policy labels, sandbox metadata | T001 |
397	| M7-T004 | Permission policy layer: allow/ask/deny resolution with structured JSON policy records | T003 |
398	| M7-T005 | Slash-style invocation: `kca skill run <name> [args] [--dry-run]` shows permissions + rendered prompt | T001, T004 |
399	| M7-T006 | Audit logging: record every tool execution in `agent_job_events` with policy decision | T004 |
400	| M7-T007 | Seed `.kca/skills/` with `run-milestone`, `triage-log`, `prepare-submission`, `review-pr` | T001 |
401	| M7-T008 | `tests/test_m7_smoke.py`: skill parsing, arg substitution, permission resolution, command registry, decision gates | T001–T006 |
402	| M7-T009 | Documentation: `docs/architecture/kca-cli-architecture.md` explaining Commands vs Skills vs Tools vs Jobs | all |
403	| M7-T010 | M7 exit criteria validation + `docs/m7-final-review.md` | all |
404	
405	### Permission policy design
406	
407	Runtime agent permissions are data, not ad-hoc prompts:
408	
409	```json
410	{
411	  "operation": "kaggle.submit",
412	  "default_decision": "ask",
413	  "reason": "External competition submission",
414	  "allowed_in_modes": ["human-approved", "competition-finalization"],
415	  "audit_required": true
416	}
417	```
418	
419	Allow by default: edit workspace files, run tests/benchmark, create artifacts,
420	summarize logs, call LiteLLM/local models, create branch, commit, create PR.
421	
422	Decision gate: submit to Kaggle, merge PR, publish dataset/kernel, apply
423	remote Supabase migration, spend above budget threshold, change model tier,
424	change competition direction/objective.
425	
426	Deny: read secrets, write outside workspace, sudo/root, rm outside workspace,
427	drop database/schema, force push, network exfiltration.
428	
429	### Recommended directory layout
430	
431	```text
432	.kca/
433	  skills/
434	    run-milestone/SKILL.md
435	    triage-log/SKILL.md
436	    prepare-submission/SKILL.md
437	    review-pr/SKILL.md
438	  tools/tools.yaml
439	  permissions/
440	    default.yaml
441	    permissive-dev.yaml
442	    competition-runner.yaml
443	
444	tools/kca/
445	  kca.py
446	  commands/
447	    job.py  skill.py  tool.py  decision.py
448	    workspace.py  kaggle.py  supabase.py
449	  agent/
450	    runner.py  skill_loader.py  tool_executor.py
451	    permission_policy.py  audit.py
452	```
453	
454	Exit criteria:
455	
456	- `kca skill list` shows available skills from `.kca/skills/`.
457	- `kca skill show <name>` prints parsed metadata and body.
458	- `kca skill run <name> ... --dry-run` prints planned tool permissions and rendered prompt without executing.
459	- Permission policy resolves allow/ask/deny for any (operation, mode) pair.
460	- Audit log records every tool execution with policy decision.
461	- `.github/workflows/` CI passes on main branch (no-db + lint at minimum).
462	- `tests/test_m7_smoke.py` passes without API keys or DB.
463	- Documentation explains Commands vs Skills vs Tools vs Jobs.

##### 👀 Read `milestone-loop-protocol.md`

````
1	# Milestone Loop Protocol
2	
3	_Shared rules that apply to every milestone Loop Prompt (M0+) unless a
4	milestone explicitly overrides one._
5	
6	Each `docs/m*-loop-prompts.md` should reference this file once at the top
7	rather than duplicating the rules per prompt.
8	
9	---
10	
11	## 1. Sequencing
12	
13	- Loop Prompts within a milestone MUST execute in order.
14	- Each prompt's **acceptance checks MUST pass** before moving to the next.
15	- On failure: fix the specific issue and **retry that prompt only**; do
16	  not skip ahead and do not redo prompts that already passed.
17	
18	## 2. External systems and side effects
19	
20	- Do NOT call the **real Anthropic API or Kaggle API** outside of paths
21	  the milestone explicitly designates as live; default to `--dry-run`.
22	- Do NOT run real **Kaggle submit / kernel push / dataset upload /
23	  model upload** unless the milestone explicitly requests it AND a
24	  human-approval record exists.
25	- Do NOT change **production Supabase**.
26	
27	## 3. Database validation
28	
29	- Use `SUPABASE_DB_URL=postgresql://postgres:s3cr3t@172.21.0.4:5432/postgres`
30	  — the `supabase-db` container on the local Docker network.
31	- Container IPs change on `docker compose down/up`; refresh with:
32	  ```bash
33	  docker inspect supabase-db \
34	    --format '{{range .NetworkSettings.Networks}}{{.IPAddress}}{{end}}'
35	  ```
36	- DB calls and LAN-host calls require `dangerouslyDisableSandbox=true`.
37	  Cloud LLM calls stay **inside** the sandbox.
38	
39	## 4. Reporting
40	
41	- Report **PASS / FAIL / SKIP** inline for each prompt's verification
42	  step.
43	- At milestone end, write the milestone's defined **Closeout format**
44	  (see each milestone's last Loop Prompt for the exact fields).
45	
46	## 5. Git / GitHub — worktree mode
47	
48	This project executes each milestone inside a dedicated **git worktree**
49	branched off `main`.
50	
51	- **Mid-milestone, mid-prompt:** do not `git commit` or `git push`
52	  unless the individual task spec explicitly says so. Stage with
53	  `git add` and surface diffs in the inline report.
54	- **At milestone end** — once every Loop Prompt has PASSed and the
55	  milestone's Closeout has been written — Claude Code SHOULD:
56	  1. `git add` only the files listed in the Closeout's "files changed"
57	     section (or its equivalent).
58	  2. `git commit` using either:
59	     - one squash commit per milestone, OR
60	     - one commit per Loop Prompt,
61	     depending on the milestone's preference. The default is **one
62	     commit per Loop Prompt**, with the milestone's final review as the
63	     last commit.
64	  3. `git push` the worktree's branch to the remote.
65	  4. `gh pr create` against `main` using the milestone's
66	     `docs/m{N}-final-review.md` as the PR body.
67	
68	- The following **still require explicit human approval** at any time:
69	  - `git push --force` (any branch)
70	  - `gh pr merge` (any PR)
71	  - any push to `main` directly
72	  - any `gh label create/edit/delete`, `gh issue edit/comment`,
73	    `gh pr edit/comment` against issues or PRs **not** owned by this
74	    milestone
75	
76	- If the milestone's task spec or scope says
77	  "do not commit / push / open PRs", that override **wins** — typically
78	  used for planning-only or evidence-only milestones.
79	
80	## 6. Secrets and forbidden reads
81	
82	These are always denied, regardless of milestone:
83	
84	- `.env*`
85	- `**/kaggle.json`, `~/.kaggle/kaggle.json`
86	- `~/.ssh/id_rsa`, `~/.ssh/id_ed25519`, any private key contents
87	- `~/.aws/**`, `~/.config/gcloud/**`
88	- `secrets/**`
89	
90	Shell commands that would surface the above (`cat`, `grep`, `head`,
91	`tail`, `less`, `more`, file uploads) over these paths are blocked at
92	the hook layer.
93	
94	---
95	
96	## How a milestone references this file
97	
98	In each Loop Prompt block, instead of repeating the rules above, include
99	one line near the top:
100	
101	```
102	Follow: docs/milestone-loop-protocol.md
103	```
104	
105	A milestone's `docs/m{N}-loop-prompts.md` should still spell out:
106	
107	- the milestone's own scope, non-goals, and task list;
108	- per-Loop-Prompt read lists, scope, acceptance criteria;
109	- any **override** of a default in this file (e.g. a planning-only
110	  milestone overriding the worktree commit/push behavior).
111	
````

1	# M9-T002: Worker baseline LR loop → submission.csv
2	
3	## Milestone
4	M9: live end-to-end regression test — Spaceship Titanic.
5	
6	## Goal
7	Drive the M3 AgentWorker through a complete baseline experiment loop for
8	Spaceship Titanic: research → baseline LogisticRegression → cross-validation
9	→ `submission.csv`. The result is a *staged* submission file and a CV
10	score recorded in the `runs` table. **No** real Kaggle submission.
11	
12	This task assumes **M9-T000 and M9-T001 closeouts are PASS**.
13	
14	## Read first
15	
16	1. M9-T001 closeout
17	2. `src/worker/worker.py`, `src/worker/budget.py`, `src/worker/tools.py`,
18	   `src/worker/reviewer.py`, `src/worker/routing.py`
19	3. `tools/kca/run.py` (run-init + record-metric)
20	4. `tools/kca/skill.py` (`kca skill run --execute`)
21	5. `.kca/skills/kaggle-experiment-loop/SKILL.md`
22	6. `supabase/migrations/0005_m5_research_citations.sql`,
23	   `supabase/migrations/0006_m6_reviews_spans.sql`
24	7. `docs/architecture/kca-cli-architecture.md`
25	
26	## Submission-format note
27	
28	**Spaceship Titanic accepts CSV submissions only** (`PassengerId,Transported`).
29	The current `tools/kca/kg.py::cmd_submit` is format-agnostic — it shells
30	out to `kaggle competitions submit -c <slug> -f <file> -m <msg>` with the
31	file path verbatim, and lets the Kaggle server validate the format. KCA
32	does **not** read competition rules at runtime to confirm the expected
33	submission format or pick between `submit` (CSV / zip) and `push` (kernel
34	notebook).
35	
36	For M9 this is acceptable because Spaceship Titanic is a CSV competition.
37	For other competitions (code competitions → kernels via `kca kaggle push`;
38	some CV competitions → `submission.zip`; some structured competitions →
39	JSON), the executor must know the format up front; KCA will not auto-detect.
40	
41	A follow-up issue tracks adding runtime format awareness to KCA
42	(see `area:kaggle` / `type:feature` issues filed alongside this milestone).
43	That work is **not** in scope for M9-T002 or any other M9 task — M9 uses
44	the existing `submit` surface and assumes CSV for Spaceship Titanic.
45	
46	## Scope
47	
48	1. `kca run init --competition spaceship-titanic --name baseline-lr` to
49	   create a run artifact directory under
50	   `runs/spaceship-titanic/baseline-lr/`.
51	2. Execute the kaggle-experiment-loop skill via
52	   `kca skill run kaggle-experiment-loop --execute --arg metric=Accuracy`
53	   (or equivalent — match the skill's declared arguments).
54	3. Inside the worker, produce:
55	   - a brief research summary citing competition page + 1–2 forum
56	     references (M5 surface);
57	   - a baseline `LogisticRegression` model trained on `train.csv` with
58	     a deterministic CV split (seed pinned, recorded in the run meta);
59	   - CV accuracy recorded via `kca run record-metric` (writes to `runs`).
60	4. Produce `runs/spaceship-titanic/baseline-lr/submission.csv` matching
61	   the `sample_submission.csv` schema (`PassengerId`, `Transported`).
62	5. Quick sanity validation: row count == test.csv row count; columns
63	   match sample; values are booleans (or 0/1).
64	
65	## Non-goals
66	
67	- Do not call `kca kaggle submit`. The submission file is *staged* only.
68	- Do not push a kernel.
69	- Do not iterate beyond the baseline within this Loop Prompt — feature
70	  engineering and HGB are M9-T005.
71	- Do not call the real Anthropic API outside skill-declared paths; if the
72	  worker is run with `--dry-run`, that's acceptable — record the
73	  dry-run flag in the closeout.
74	
75	## Acceptance criteria
76	
77	- `runs/spaceship-titanic/baseline-lr/submission.csv` exists.
78	- A row in `runs` references the baseline run with a recorded CV metric.
79	- Sanity validation passes (row count, column names, value types).
80	- `kca run list --competition spaceship-titanic --json` shows the run.
```

4	from __future__ import annotations
5	
6	import json
7	import os
8	import sys
9	from datetime import datetime, timezone
10	from pathlib import Path
11	
12	
13	def main() -> int:
14	    try:
15	        payload = json.load(sys.stdin)
16	    except Exception as exc:
17	        payload = {"parse_error": str(exc)}
18	
19	    project_dir = Path(os.environ.get("CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR", "."))
20	    log_dir = project_dir / ".agent" / "audit"
21	    log_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
22	
23	    event = {
24	        "timestamp": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
25	        "hook_event_name": payload.get("hook_event_name"),
26	        "tool_name": payload.get("tool_name"),
27	        "session_id": payload.get("session_id"),
28	        "cwd": payload.get("cwd"),
29	        "payload": payload,
30	    }
31	
32	    with (log_dir / "tool-events.jsonl").open("a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
33	        f.write(json.dumps(event, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
34	
35	    return 0
36	
37	
38	if __name__ == "__main__":
39	    raise SystemExit(main())

65	## DB access note
66	
67	DB validation reused the M5/M6/M7/M8/M8.5 path: container IP DSN
68	`postgresql://postgres:s3cr3t@172.21.0.4:5432/postgres`. The container
69	IP rotates on `docker compose down/up`; refresh via
70	`docker inspect supabase-db --format '{{range .NetworkSettings.Networks}}{{.IPAddress}}{{end}}'`.
71	
72	DB checks that needed `dangerouslyDisableSandbox=true`:
73	- `kca run list --competition spaceship-titanic --json` (READ_ONLY against `experiment_runs`, `experiments`, `run_metrics`).
74	- `submissions` row inspection via `psql`.
75	- Live-DB pytest sweep (98 passed / 0 skipped when `.env` is shadowed to an empty file in a tmp tree — see "Known caveat" below).
76	
77	Live-DB pytest **inside the dev shell** surfaces 3 pre-existing failures
78	that are not M9 regressions:
79	
80	- `tests/test_kca_smoke.py::test_kaggle_submit_blocked_without_env`
81	- `tests/test_m4_smoke.py::test_kaggle_submit_no_credentials`
82	- `tests/test_m9_e2e.py::test_kca_kaggle_submit_refuses_without_credentials`
83	
84	Root cause: `tools/kca/db.py` calls `dotenv.load_dotenv(<repo-root>/.env, override=False)` at import time. With the sandbox engaged, `.env` is bind-mounted to `/dev/null` (loads nothing — tests PASS, see row 26 above). With `dangerouslyDisableSandbox=true` the real `.env` becomes readable and re-injects `KAGGLE_USERNAME`/`KAGGLE_KEY` into the subprocess environment, so the "refuses without credentials" assertion fails. This is **cross-cutting follow-up B** (M8.5 carry-over → M10). Both sandbox-mode pytest and the shadow-tree pytest (`tmp/.../.env` empty) are clean — only the unshadowed live-DB run on a host shell with a populated `.env` exhibits the leak. Filed in `docs/handoffs/m9-handoff.md` for the user to issue post-merge.

1	# kaggle-code-agent (kca)
2	
3	A hybrid human + AI workbench for competitive programming: Kaggle competitions, authorized CTF/lab challenges, Devpost hackathons, and similar code contests.
4	
5	The platform is **local-first and audit-first**. Every research note, experiment, code change, test result, approval, and submission is traceable.
6	
7	## Two meanings of "code agent"
8	
9	This project uses two related but distinct concepts.
10	
11	**Platform-development coding agents** are external AI tools — Claude Code (primary), ChatGPT, Cursor — used to build this repository. They write source code, update docs, run local tests, and open PRs under human supervision.
12	
13	**Runtime competition code agents** are agents launched by the finished platform to help a human user compete. Initial runtime: Claude Agent SDK in an isolated Python worker. Future: model router for Claude (Sonnet/Opus), GPT-style models, and local vLLM/Ollama models.
14	
15	See `docs/architecture/platform-vs-runtime-agents.md` for the full breakdown.
16	
17	## Source of truth
18	
19	**GitHub repo + Claude Code + CI + Supabase migrations.**
20	
21	AI tools do not share hidden memory reliably across sessions or products. All decisions, architecture, task specs, and safety rules must live in repo files. Claude Code is the primary development environment for all product layers (CLI, backend, UI shell, worker).
22	
23	Key files:
24	- `PROJECT_STATE.md` — current project snapshot and open decisions
25	- `AGENTS.md` — cross-tool instructions for ChatGPT, Codex, Cursor, and other agents
26	- `CLAUDE.md` — Claude Code-specific instructions and safety boundaries
27	- `docs/adr/` — architecture decision records
28	- `docs/milestones.md` — product plan from M0 through M13

288	        return str(value)
289	    if isinstance(value, dict):
290	        return {str(k): _to_data(v) for k, v in value.items()}
291	    if isinstance(value, (list, tuple)):
292	        return [_to_data(x) for x in value]
293	    return value

308	def _print_table(rows: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> None:
309	    headers = [
310	        ("run_id", "run_id"),
311	        ("name", "name"),
312	        ("action", "action"),
313	        ("version_label", "slug_ver"),
314	        ("version", "kernel_ver"),
315	        ("status", "status"),
316	        ("submit_state", "submit"),
317	        ("url", "url"),
318	    ]
319	    if not rows:
320	        print("(no runs)")
321	        return
322	    widths = {k: len(title) for k, title in headers}
323	    for row in rows:
324	        for k, _ in headers:
325	            widths[k] = max(widths[k], len(str(row.get(k, "") or "")))
326	    print("  ".join(title.ljust(widths[k]) for k, title in headers))
327	    print("  ".join("-" * widths[k] for k, _ in headers))
328	    for row in rows:
329	        print("  ".join(str(row.get(k, "") or "").ljust(widths[k]) for k, _ in headers))
330

332	def _emit_ok(args: argparse.Namespace, **payload: Any) -> int:
333	    data = {"ok": True, **_to_data(payload)}
334	    if getattr(args, "json", False):
335	        print(json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False))
336	    elif data.get("action") == ACTION_LIST and "runs" in data:
337	        _print_table(list(data.get("runs") or []))
338	    else:
339	        for key in (
340	            "action",
341	            "name",
342	            "run_id",
343	            "status",
344	            "submit_state",
345	            "run_dir",
346	            "base_kernel_ref",
347	            "kernel_ref",
348	            "url",
349	        ):
350	            value = data.get(key)
351	            if value is not None:
352	                print(f"{key}: {value}")
353	    return EXIT_OK

390	def _as_relpath(path_value: str | Path, *, start: Path | None = None) -> str:
391	    base = (start or Path.cwd()).resolve()
392	    path = _resolve_stored_path(path_value, base=base)
393	    try:
394	        rel = os.path.relpath(str(path), str(base))
395	    except Exception:
396	        return str(path)
397	    if rel == ".":
398	        return "./"
399	    return rel if rel.startswith(".") else f"./{rel}"

410	def _normalize_list(value: Any) -> list[Any]:
411	    if value is None:
412	        return []
413	    if isinstance(value, list):
414	        return value
415	    if isinstance(value, tuple):
416	        return list(value)
417	    return [value]
418	
419	
420	def _deep_merge(base: dict[str, Any], override: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
421	    def union_list(left: list[Any], right: list[Any]) -> list[Any]:
422	        out: list[Any] = []
423	        seen: set[str] = set()
424	        for item in left + right:
425	            key = (
426	                json.dumps(item, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False)
427	                if isinstance(item, (dict, list))
428	                else repr(item)
429	            )
430	            if key in seen:
431	                continue
432	            seen.add(key)
433	            out.append(item)
434	        return out
435	
436	    merged = dict(base)
437	    for key, value in override.items():
438	        if key not in merged:
439	            merged[key] = value
440	            continue
441	        base_value = merged[key]
442	        if isinstance(base_value, dict) and isinstance(value, dict):
443	            merged[key] = _deep_merge(base_value, value)
444	        elif isinstance(base_value, list) and isinstance(value, list):
445	            merged[key] = union_list(base_value, value)
446	        else:
447	            merged[key] = value
448	    return merged
449	
450	
451	def _attr(obj: Any, *names: str, default: Any = None) -> Any:
452	    if isinstance(obj, dict):
453	        for name in names:
454	            if name in obj:
455	                return obj[name]
456	        return default
457	    for name in names:
458	        if hasattr(obj, name):
459	            return getattr(obj, name)
460	    return default

463	def _slug_parts(kernel_ref: str) -> tuple[str, str]:
464	    parts = str(kernel_ref).strip().split("/", 1)
465	    if len(parts) != 2 or not parts[0] or not parts[1]:
466	        raise ValueError("config 'id' must be in the form 'owner/slug'")
467	    return parts[0], parts[1]

470	def _is_blank(value: Any) -> bool:
471	    return value is None or (isinstance(value, str) and not value.strip())

474	def _dataclass_from_dict(cls: Any, data: dict[str, Any]) -> Any:
475	    allowed = {f.name for f in fields(cls)}
476	    filtered = {k: v for k, v in dict(data or {}).items() if k in allowed}
477	    return cls(**filtered)

480	def _load_yaml_config(path: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
481	    if not path.exists():
482	        raise FileNotFoundError(f"config file not found: {path}")
483	    data = yaml.safe_load(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
484	    if not isinstance(data, dict):
485	        raise ValueError("yaml root must be a mapping")
486	    return data

488	
489	def _merged_config(path: Path, name: str) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], dict[str, str]]:
490	    data = _load_yaml_config(path)
491	    if "_base" not in data:
492	        raise ValueError("yaml must contain a '_base' block")
493	    if name not in data:
494	        raise ValueError(f"configuration block not found: {name}")
495	    env_map_raw = data.get("_envs") or {}
496	    if not isinstance(env_map_raw, dict):
497	        raise ValueError("_envs must be a mapping")
498	    env_map = {
499	        str(k): str(v)
500	        for k, v in env_map_raw.items()
501	        if not _is_blank(k) and not _is_blank(v)
502	    }
503	    cfg = _deep_merge(dict(data.get("_base") or {}), dict(data.get(name) or {}))
504	    for key in REQUIRED_CFG_KEYS:
505	        if _is_blank(cfg.get(key)):
506	            raise ValueError(f"missing required config key after merge: {key}")
507	    for list_key in LIST_CFG_KEYS:
508	        cfg[list_key] = _normalize_list(cfg.get(list_key))
509	    cfg["id"] = str(cfg["id"]).strip()
510	    cfg["title"] = str(cfg["title"]).strip()
511	    cfg["code_file"] = str(cfg["code_file"]).strip()
512	    cfg["language"] = str(cfg.get("language") or "python").strip()
513	    cfg["kernel_type"] = str(cfg.get("kernel_type") or "notebook").strip()
514	    cfg.setdefault("submit_type", "notebook")
515	    cfg.setdefault("submit_file", "submission.csv")
516	    cfg.setdefault("_msg", "kkr_auto_submit@{ts}")
517	    cfg.setdefault("_stub", None)
518	    cfg.setdefault("_versioned_slug", False)
519	    cfg.setdefault("_version_width", 4)
520	    cfg["owner"], cfg["slug"] = _slug_parts(cfg["id"])
521	    return cfg, env_map

532	    env_map: dict[str, str] | None = None,
533	) -> str | None:

540	    else:

546	    if env_override:

563	def _apply_runtime_overrides(
564	    cfg: dict[str, Any], args: argparse.Namespace, *, action: str
565	) -> dict[str, Any]:
566	    out = dict(cfg)
567	
568	    stub_override = getattr(args, "stub", None)
569	    if stub_override is not None:
570	        out["_stub"] = stub_override
571	
572	    if action == ACTION_SUBMIT:
573	        msg_override = getattr(args, "msg", None)
574	        if msg_override is not None:
575	            msg_override = str(msg_override)
576	            base = str(out.get("_msg") or "kkr@{ts}")
577	            if msg_override.startswith("+"):
578	                extra = msg_override[1:].strip()
579	                out["_msg"] = f"{base} {extra}".strip() if extra else base
580	            else:
581	                out["_msg"] = msg_override
582	        _format_submit_message(out.get("_msg"))
583	
584	    return out

624	    return [str(tag) for tag in cell.metadata.get("tags", []) if str(tag).strip()]

627	def _should_drop_for_action(
628	    cell: Any, action: str, cfg: dict[str, Any]
629	) -> tuple[bool, str | None]:
630	    tags = [tag.lower() for tag in _normalize_tags(cell)]
631	    drop_tags = {str(tag).lower() for tag in _normalize_list(cfg.get("_drop_tags"))}
632	    if cell.cell_type == "markdown":
633	        return True, "markdown"
634	    if action == ACTION_SUBMIT and any(tag in drop_tags for tag in tags):
635	        return True, "drop_tag"
636	    if action == ACTION_SUBMIT and any(DEBUG_TAG_RE.match(tag) for tag in tags):
637	        return True, "debug"
638	    return False, None

641	def build_notebook(
642	    src_path: Path,
643	    dst_path: Path,
644	    action: str,
645	    cfg: dict[str, Any],
646	    stub_code: str | None = None,
647	) -> dict[str, Any]:
648	    notebook = _load_notebook(src_path)
649	    new_cells = []
650	    dropped_markdown = dropped_debug = dropped_tagged = stubbed = 0
651	    for cell in notebook.cells:
652	        drop, reason = _should_drop_for_action(cell, action, cfg)
653	        if drop:
654	            if reason == "markdown":
655	                dropped_markdown += 1
656	            elif reason == "debug":
657	                dropped_debug += 1
658	            else:
659	                dropped_tagged += 1
660	            continue
661	        new_cell = copy.deepcopy(cell)
662	        if getattr(new_cell, "cell_type", None) == "code":
663	            new_cell.outputs = []
664	            new_cell.execution_count = None
665	            if stub_code is not None and any(
666	                tag.lower() == "stub" for tag in _normalize_tags(new_cell)
667	            ):
668	                new_cell.source = bytes(stub_code, "utf-8").decode("unicode_escape")
669	                stubbed += 1
670	        new_cells.append(new_cell)
671	    notebook.cells = new_cells
672	    _ensure_papermill_metadata(notebook)
673	    _save_notebook(dst_path, notebook)
674	    return {
675	        "src": _as_relpath(src_path),
676	        "dst": _as_relpath(dst_path),
677	        "action": action,
678	        "kept_cells": len(new_cells),
679	        "dropped_markdown_cells": dropped_markdown,
680	        "dropped_debug_cells": dropped_debug,
681	        "dropped_tagged_cells": dropped_tagged,
682	        "stubbed_cells": stubbed,
683	    }

713	def _coerce_push_result(resp: Any) -> PushResult:
714	    if resp is None:
715	        return PushResult()
716	    if hasattr(resp, "to_dict"):
717	        try:
718	            raw = resp.to_dict()
719	        except Exception:
720	            raw = {"result": str(resp)}
721	    elif isinstance(resp, dict):
722	        raw = dict(resp)
723	    else:
724	        raw = {
725	            f: _attr(resp, f, default=None)
726	            for f in PUSH_RESULT_FIELDS
727	            if _attr(resp, f, default=None) is not None
728	        }
729	        if not raw:
730	            raw = {"result": str(resp)}
731	    kernel_id = _attr(raw, "kernel_id", "kernelId", default=None)
732	    version_number = _attr(raw, "version_number", "versionNumber", default=None)
733	    try:
734	        kernel_id = int(kernel_id) if kernel_id not in (None, "") else None
735	    except Exception:
736	        kernel_id = None
737	    try:
738	        version_number = (
739	            int(version_number) if version_number not in (None, "") else None
740	        )
741	    except Exception:
742	        version_number = None
743	    return PushResult(
744	        ref=_attr(raw, "ref", default=None),
745	        url=_attr(raw, "url", default=None),
746	        error=_attr(raw, "error", default=None),
747	        kernel_id=kernel_id,
748	        version_number=version_number,
749	        invalid_tags=_normalize_list(_attr(raw, "invalidTags", default=[])),
750	        invalid_dataset_sources=_normalize_list(
751	            _attr(raw, "invalidDatasetSources", default=[])
752	        ),
753	        invalid_competition_sources=_normalize_list(
754	            _attr(raw, "invalidCompetitionSources", default=[])
755	        ),
756	        invalid_kernel_sources=_normalize_list(
757	            _attr(raw, "invalidKernelSources", default=[])
758	        ),
759	        invalid_model_sources=_normalize_list(
760	            _attr(raw, "invalidModelSources", default=[])
761	        ),
762	        raw=raw,
763	    )
764

774	def parse_kernel_status(status_resp: Any) -> str:
775	    text = _status_text(status_resp).lower()
776	    if not text:
777	        return "unknown"
778	    if any(x in text for x in ("cancelled", "canceled", "cancel")):
779	        return "cancelled"
780	    if any(x in text for x in ("complete", "completed", "success")):
781	        return "complete"
782	    if "running" in text:
783	        return "running"
784	    if any(x in text for x in ("queued", "pending")):
785	        return "queued"
786	    if any(x in text for x in ("error", "failed")):
787	        return "error"
788	    return text

874	def _scan_highest_version(run_root: Path, base_kernel_ref: str) -> int:
875	    highest = 0
876	    for entry in _list_registry_entries(run_root):
877	        if (entry.base_kernel_ref or entry.kernel_ref) != base_kernel_ref:
878	            continue
879	        if entry.version_label:
880	            m = VERSION_LABEL_RE.match(entry.version_label)
881	            if m:
882	                highest = max(highest, int(m.group(1)))
883	    return highest

886	def _preview_or_allocate_version(
887	    run_root: Path, base_kernel_ref: str, *, width: int, allocate: bool
888	) -> str:
889	    index = _load_version_index(run_root)
890	    current = max(
891	        int(index.get(base_kernel_ref, 0) or 0),
892	        _scan_highest_version(run_root, base_kernel_ref),
893	    )
894	    nxt = current + 1
895	    if allocate:
896	        index[base_kernel_ref] = nxt
897	        _save_version_index(run_root, index)
898	    return f"v{nxt:0{max(1, width)}d}"

922	def _score_to_number(value: Any) -> float | str | None:
923	    if value in (None, ""):
924	        return None
925	    if isinstance(value, (int, float)):
926	        return float(value)
927	    try:
928	        return float(str(value).strip())
929	    except Exception:
930	        text = str(value).strip()
931	        return text or None
932	
933	
934	def _extract_score_from_item(item: Any) -> float | str | None:
935	    for key in SCORE_KEYS:
936	        score = _score_to_number(_attr(item, key, default=None))
937	        if score is not None:
938	            return score
939	    return None
940	
941	
942	def _best_effort_score_info(api: Any, competition: str | None) -> ScoreInfo:
943	    if not competition:
944	        return ScoreInfo()
945	    for source_name, method_name in (
946	        ("competition_submissions", "competition_submissions"),
947	        ("competition_submissions_cli", "competition_submissions_cli"),
948	    ):
949	        method = getattr(api, method_name, None)
950	        if not callable(method):
951	            continue
952	        try:
953	            raw = method(competition)
954	        except TypeError:
955	            try:
956	                raw = method(competition=competition)
957	            except Exception:
958	                continue
959	        except Exception:
960	            continue
961	        items = (
962	            raw
963	            if isinstance(raw, list)
964	            else _normalize_list(_attr(raw, "submissions", default=[]))
965	        )
966	        scores = [
967	            s
968	            for s in (_extract_score_from_item(item) for item in items)
969	            if s is not None
970	        ]
971	        numeric = [s for s in scores if isinstance(s, float)]
972	        latest = scores[0] if scores else None
973	        best_public = max(numeric) if numeric else None
974	        return ScoreInfo(
975	            latest_submission_score=latest,
976	            best_public_score=best_public,
977	            pb_score=best_public if best_public is not None else latest,
978	            score_source=source_name,
979	            raw={"count": len(items)},
980	        )
981	    return ScoreInfo()

984	def _output_file_candidates(run_dir: Path, submit_file: str) -> list[Path]:
985	    path = Path(submit_file)
986	    candidates = []
987	    for name in (
988	        submit_file,
989	        path.name,
990	        f"{DEFAULT_OUTPUT_DIRNAME}/{path.name}",
991	        f"{DEFAULT_SOURCE_DIRNAME}/{path.name}",
992	    ):
993	        candidate = run_dir / name
994	        if candidate.exists() and candidate.is_file():
995	            candidates.append(candidate)
996	    out_root = run_dir / DEFAULT_OUTPUT_DIRNAME
997	    if out_root.exists():
998	        candidates.extend([p for p in sorted(out_root.rglob(path.name)) if p.is_file()])
999	    uniq = []
1000	    seen = set()
1001	    for p in candidates:
1002	        key = str(p.resolve())
1003	        if key not in seen:
1004	            seen.add(key)
1005	            uniq.append(p)
1006	    return uniq

1028	def _unpack_zip_files(run_dir: Path) -> list[str]:
1029	    extracted = []
1030	    root = run_dir / DEFAULT_OUTPUT_DIRNAME
1031	    if not root.exists():
1032	        return extracted
1033	    for zip_path in sorted(root.rglob("*.zip")):
1034	        target = run_dir / DEFAULT_ZIP_DIRNAME / zip_path.stem
1035	        _ensure_dir(target)
1036	        with zipfile.ZipFile(zip_path, "r") as zf:
1037	            zf.extractall(target)
1038	        extracted.append(_as_relpath(target))
1039	    return extracted

1095	def _determine_submit_state(
1096	    entry: RegistryEntry, manifest: RunManifest, current_status: str | None = None
1097	) -> str:
1098	    sr = dict(manifest.submit_result or {})
1099	    if sr:
1100	        state = str(sr.get("state") or "").strip()
1101	        if state:
1102	            return state
1103	        return "submitted" if sr.get("ok") else "failed"
1104	    if entry.action == ACTION_SUBMIT:
1105	        return (
1106	            "pending_competition_submit"
1107	            if (current_status or entry.status) in SUCCESS_STATUSES
1108	            else "pending_kernel_success"
1109	        )
1110	    return entry.submit_state or "not_applicable"

1130	def _resolve_selector(
1131	    run_root: Path, args: argparse.Namespace, *, allow_missing_name: bool = False
1132	) -> RegistryEntry:
1133	    if getattr(args, "run", None):
1134	        return _load_registry(run_root, args.run)
1135	    entries = _list_registry_entries(run_root)
1136	    if getattr(args, "kernel", None):
1137	        entries = [x for x in entries if x.kernel_ref == args.kernel]
1138	    if getattr(args, "name", None):
1139	        entries = [x for x in entries if x.name == args.name]
1140	    if getattr(args, "version", None) is not None:
1141	        entries = [x for x in entries if x.version_number == args.version]
1142	    if not entries:
1143	        if (
1144	            allow_missing_name
1145	            and not getattr(args, "name", None)
1146	            and not getattr(args, "kernel", None)
1147	            and getattr(args, "version", None) is None
1148	        ):
1149	            raise ValueError("please provide NAME, --run, or --kernel/--version")
1150	        raise FileNotFoundError("no matching run found")
1151	    return entries[0]

1163	def _competition_submit(
1164	    api: Any,
1165	    cfg: dict[str, Any],
1166	    run_dir: Path,
1167	    entry: RegistryEntry,
1168	    manifest: RunManifest,
1169	) -> CompetitionSubmitResult:
1170	    manifest = _prepare_submit_artifacts(run_dir, entry, manifest, cfg)
1171	    competition = cfg.get("competition")
1172	    submit_type = str(cfg.get("submit_type") or "notebook").lower()
1173	    message = _format_submit_message(cfg.get("_msg"))
1174	    if not competition:
1175	        result = CompetitionSubmitResult(
1176	            ok=False, state="unsupported", message="competition is not configured"
1177	        )
1178	    elif submit_type == "notebook":
1179	        if entry.version_number in (None, 0):
1180	            result = CompetitionSubmitResult(
1181	                ok=False,
1182	                state="failed",
1183	                message="kernel version is missing; cannot call competition_submit_code",
1184	            )
1185	        else:
1186	            try:
1187	                resp = api.competition_submit_code(
1188	                    competition=competition,
1189	                    file_name=cfg.get("submit_file") or "submission.csv",
1190	                    kernel=entry.kernel_ref,
1191	                    kernel_version=entry.version_number,
1192	                    message=message,
1193	                    quiet=False,
1194	                )
1195	                raw = (
1196	                    resp.to_dict()
1197	                    if hasattr(resp, "to_dict")
1198	                    else (
1199	                        dict(resp) if isinstance(resp, dict) else {"result": str(resp)}
1200	                    )
1201	                )
1202	                result = CompetitionSubmitResult(
1203	                    ok=True,
1204	                    state="submitted",
1205	                    message=_attr(raw, "message", default=None),
1206	                    ref=_attr(raw, "ref", default=None),
1207	                    raw=raw,
1208	                )
1209	            except Exception as exc:
1210	                result = CompetitionSubmitResult(
1211	                    ok=False, state="failed", message=str(exc), raw={"error": str(exc)}
1212	                )
1213	    elif submit_type == "local":
1214	        candidates = _output_file_candidates(
1215	            run_dir, str(cfg.get("submit_file") or "submission.csv")
1216	        )
1217	        if not candidates:
1218	            result = CompetitionSubmitResult(
1219	                ok=False,
1220	                state="failed",
1221	                message=f"submit file not found under {run_dir}: {cfg.get('submit_file')}",
1222	            )
1223	        else:
1224	            try:
1225	                resp = api.competition_submit(
1226	                    file_name=str(candidates[0]),
1227	                    competition=competition,
1228	                    message=message,
1229	                )
1230	                raw = (
1231	                    resp.to_dict()
1232	                    if hasattr(resp, "to_dict")
1233	                    else (
1234	                        dict(resp) if isinstance(resp, dict) else {"result": str(resp)}
1235	                    )
1236	                )
1237	                result = CompetitionSubmitResult(
1238	                    ok=True,
1239	                    state="submitted",
1240	                    message=_attr(raw, "message", default=None),
1241	                    ref=_attr(raw, "ref", default=None),
1242	                    raw=raw,
1243	                )
1244	            except Exception as exc:
1245	                result = CompetitionSubmitResult(
1246	                    ok=False, state="failed", message=str(exc), raw={"error": str(exc)}
1247	                )
1248	    else:
1249	        result = CompetitionSubmitResult(
1250	            ok=False,
1251	            state="unsupported",
1252	            message=f"unsupported submit_type: {submit_type}",
1253	        )
1254	    manifest.submit_result = _to_data(result)
1255	    _write_json(run_dir / DEFAULT_SUBMIT_FILENAME, result)
1256	    _save_manifest(run_dir, manifest)
1257	    entry.submit_state = result.state
1258	    return result

1261	def _competition_submit_with_retry(
1262	    api: Any,
1263	    cfg: dict[str, Any],
1264	    run_dir: Path,
1265	    entry: RegistryEntry,
1266	    manifest: RunManifest,
1267	    *,
1268	    timeout_seconds: int = DEFAULT_SUBMIT_RETRY_TIMEOUT,
1269	    interval_seconds: int = DEFAULT_SUBMIT_RETRY_INTERVAL,
1270	    initial_delay_seconds: int = DEFAULT_SUBMIT_RETRY_INITIAL_DELAY,
1271	) -> CompetitionSubmitResult:
1272	    attempts: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
1273	    deadline = time.time() + max(0, int(timeout_seconds or 0))
1274	    last_result: CompetitionSubmitResult | None = None
1275	    if initial_delay_seconds > 0:
1276	        time.sleep(initial_delay_seconds)
1277	    while True:
1278	        try:
1279	            raw_status_obj = api.kernels_status(entry.kernel_ref)
1280	            kernel_status = parse_kernel_status(raw_status_obj)
1281	            raw_status = _status_text(raw_status_obj)
1282	        except Exception as exc:
1283	            kernel_status = "unknown"
1284	            raw_status = str(exc)
1285	        result = _competition_submit(api, cfg, run_dir, entry, manifest)
1286	        last_result = result
1287	        attempts.append(
1288	            {
1289	                "at": _now_iso(),
1290	                "kernel_status": kernel_status,
1291	                "raw_status": raw_status,
1292	                "submit_ok": result.ok,
1293	                "submit_state": result.state,
1294	                "submit_message": result.message,
1295	            }
1296	        )
1297	        if result.ok:
1298	            result.raw = dict(result.raw or {})
1299	            result.raw["submit_retry"] = {
1300	                "timeout_seconds": int(timeout_seconds or 0),
1301	                "interval_seconds": int(interval_seconds or 0),
1302	                "initial_delay_seconds": int(initial_delay_seconds or 0),
1303	                "attempts": attempts,
1304	            }
1305	            _write_json(run_dir / DEFAULT_SUBMIT_FILENAME, result)
1306	            manifest.submit_result = _to_data(result)
1307	            _save_manifest(run_dir, manifest)
1308	            entry.submit_state = result.state
1309	            return result
1310	        if time.time() >= deadline:
1311	            break
1312	        time.sleep(max(1, int(interval_seconds or 1)))
1313	    if last_result is None:
1314	        last_result = CompetitionSubmitResult(
1315	            ok=False, state="failed", message="competition submit retry exhausted"
1316	        )
1317	    last_result.raw = dict(last_result.raw or {})
1318	    last_result.raw["submit_retry"] = {
1319	        "timeout_seconds": int(timeout_seconds or 0),
1320	        "interval_seconds": int(interval_seconds or 0),
1321	        "initial_delay_seconds": int(initial_delay_seconds or 0),
1322	        "attempts": attempts,
1323	    }
1324	    _write_json(run_dir / DEFAULT_SUBMIT_FILENAME, last_result)
1325	    manifest.submit_result = _to_data(last_result)
1326	    _save_manifest(run_dir, manifest)
1327	    entry.submit_state = last_result.state
1328	    return last_result
1329

1331	def _refresh_entry_from_remote(
1332	    run_root: Path,
1333	    yaml_path: Path,
1334	    entry: RegistryEntry,

1336	    env_override: str | None = None,

1340	    api = _get_kaggle_api()

1342	    status = parse_kernel_status(raw)
1343	    raw_status = _status_text(raw)
1344	    score = (

1346	        if entry.action == ACTION_SUBMIT

1355	    run_dir = _resolve_stored_path(entry.run_dir)
1356	    manifest = _load_manifest(run_dir)
1357	    entry.submit_state = _determine_submit_state(entry, manifest, status)
1358	    _save_registry(run_root, entry)
1359	    state = RunState(

1372	        score_source=score.score_source,
1373	        submit_state=entry.submit_state,

1379	def _watch_run(
1380	    args: argparse.Namespace, *, resolved: ResolvedRun, auto_submit: bool
1381	) -> tuple[
1382	    RunState, list[dict[str, Any]], CompetitionSubmitResult | None, ScoreInfo | None
1383	]:
1384	    api = _get_kaggle_api()
1385	    history = []
1386	    deadline = (
1387	        None
1388	        if int(getattr(args, "timeout", 0) or 0) <= 0
1389	        else time.time() + int(args.timeout)
1390	    )
1391	    final_status = "unknown"
1392	    final_raw = ""
1393	    while True:
1394	        raw = api.kernels_status(resolved.entry.kernel_ref)
1395	        status = parse_kernel_status(raw)
1396	        raw_status = _status_text(raw)
1397	        at = _now_iso()
1398	
1399	        row = {"at": at, "status": status, "raw_status": raw_status}
1400	        history.append(row)
1401	        final_status, final_raw = status, raw_status
1402	        resolved.entry.status = status
1403	        resolved.entry.raw_status = raw_status
1404	        resolved.entry.updated_at = at
1405	        resolved.entry.submit_state = _determine_submit_state(
1406	            resolved.entry, resolved.manifest, status
1407	        )
1408	        _save_registry(Path(args.run_root).expanduser().resolve(), resolved.entry)
1409	        _save_state(
1410	            resolved.run_dir,
1411	            RunState(
1412	                run_id=resolved.entry.run_id,
1413	                status=status,
1414	                updated_at=at,
1415	                action=ACTION_WATCH,
1416	                raw_status=raw_status,
1417	                url=resolved.entry.url,
1418	                version_number=resolved.entry.version_number,
1419	                kernel_id=resolved.entry.kernel_id,
1420	                submit_state=resolved.entry.submit_state,
1421	            ),
1422	        )
1423	        _log(f"watch {resolved.entry.run_id}: status={status} raw={raw_status}")
1424	
1425	        if status in TERMINAL_STATUSES:
1426	            break
1427	        if not getattr(args, "wait", True):
1428	            break
1429	        if deadline is not None and time.time() >= deadline:
1430	            raise TimeoutError(f"watch timed out for {resolved.entry.run_id}")
1431	        time.sleep(
1432	            max(5, int(getattr(args, "interval", DEFAULT_INTERVAL) or DEFAULT_INTERVAL))
1433	        )
1434	    _write_json(resolved.run_dir / DEFAULT_WATCH_FILENAME, {"history": history})
1435	    submit_result = None
1436	    score = None
1437	    if (
1438	        final_status in SUCCESS_STATUSES
1439	        and auto_submit
1440	        and not resolved.manifest.submit_result
1441	    ):
1442	        submit_result = _competition_submit_with_retry(
1443	            api, resolved.cfg, resolved.run_dir, resolved.entry, resolved.manifest
1444	        )
1445	        if submit_result.ok:

2118	def _list_impl(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
2119	    run_root = Path(args.run_root).expanduser().resolve()
2120	    entries = _list_registry_entries(run_root)
2121	    if getattr(args, "run", None):
2122	        entries = [e for e in entries if e.run_id == args.run]
2123	    if getattr(args, "name", None):
2124	        entries = [e for e in entries if e.name == args.name]
2125	    if getattr(args, "kernel", None):
2126	        entries = [e for e in entries if e.kernel_ref == args.kernel]
2127	    if getattr(args, "version", None) is not None:
2128	        entries = [e for e in entries if e.version_number == args.version]
2129	    if getattr(args, "limit", None):
2130	        entries = entries[: max(1, int(args.limit))]
2131	    refreshed = 0
2132	    if getattr(args, "refresh", False):
2133	        yaml_path = Path(args.yaml).expanduser().resolve()
2134	        new_entries = []
2135	        for entry in entries:
2136	            try:
2137	                entry, _, _, _ = _refresh_entry_from_remote(
2138	                    run_root, yaml_path, entry, env_override=getattr(args, "env", None)
2139	                )
2140	                refreshed += 1
2141	            except Exception as exc:
2142	                _log(f"list refresh warning for {entry.run_id}: {exc}", "WARN")
2143	            new_entries.append(entry)
2144	        entries = new_entries
2145	    rows = [_row_from_entry(e) for e in entries]
2146	    return _emit_ok(
2147	        args,
2148	        action=ACTION_LIST,
2149	        count=len(rows),
2150	        refreshed=refreshed,
2151	        queued_count=sum(1 for e in entries if e.status in QUEUED_STATUSES),
2152	        running_count=sum(1 for e in entries if e.status == "running"),
2153	        runs=rows,
2154	    )

2157	def _build_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
2158	    common = argparse.ArgumentParser(add_help=False)
2159	    common.add_argument("--yaml", default="kkr.yaml", help="Path to kkr.yaml")
2160	    common.add_argument(
2161	        "--run-root",
2162	        default=str(DEFAULT_RUN_ROOT),
2163	        help="Root directory for run folders and registry",
2164	    )
2165	    common.add_argument("--env", help="Override dotenv path for the selected owner")
2166	    common.add_argument("--json", action="store_true", help="Emit JSON to stdout")
2167	    common.add_argument(
2168	        "--dry-run", action="store_true", help="Plan only; do not call Kaggle"
2169	    )
2170	    common.add_argument("--quiet", action="store_true", help="Suppress non-error logs")
2171	    common.add_argument(
2172	        "-v", "--verbose", action="count", default=0, help="Increase log verbosity"
2173	    )
2174	    selector = argparse.ArgumentParser(add_help=False)
2175	    selector.add_argument(
2176	        "name",
2177	        nargs="?",
2178	        help="Config name, e.g. b09m. For read actions this selects the latest matching run.",
2179	    )
2180	    selector.add_argument("--run", help="Exact RUN_ID under .kkr/")
2181	    selector.add_argument(
2182	        "--kernel",
2183	        help="Exact Kaggle kernel ref, e.g. firefly2006/gpt-oss-120b-b09m-v0006",
2184	    )
2185	    selector.add_argument(
2186	        "--version", type=int, help="Filter a registry lookup by version number"
2187	    )
2188	    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
2189	        prog="kkr.py",
2190	        description="Kaggle notebook runner with stable JSON outputs, local registry, and .kkr run tracking.",
2191	        formatter_class=argparse.RawTextHelpFormatter,
2192	    )
2193	    sub = parser.add_subparsers(dest="action", required=True)
2194	    push = sub.add_parser(
2195	        ACTION_PUSH, parents=[common], help="Build and push a Kaggle notebook run"
2196	    )
2197	    push.add_argument("name", help="Config name in kkr.yaml, e.g. b09m")
2198	    push.add_argument("--stub", help="Override _stub for this run only")
2199	    push.add_argument(
2200	        "--wait",
2201	        action="store_true",
2202	        help="Wait until the remote kernel reaches a terminal status",
2203	    )
2204	    push.add_argument(
2205	        "--interval",
2206	        type=int,
2207	        default=DEFAULT_INTERVAL,
2208	        help="Polling interval in seconds when --wait is set",
2209	    )
2210	    push.add_argument(
2211	        "--timeout",
